title: South Korea proposes AI, creatives industry initiatives during summit with ASEAN
summary: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung on Monday proposed initiatives on artificial intelligence (AI) and on the creative industries during the ASEAN-South Korea Summit in Pasay City.

blocks.text: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung on Monday proposed initiatives on artificial intelligence (AI) and on the creative industries during the ASEAN-South Korea Summit in Pasay City.
These proposals are the ASEAN-Korea AI Companionship Initiative and the ASEAN-Korea Cultural and Creative Industries Initiative.

"To ensure that everyone can share in the benefits of AI development and to ensure that the cultural creativity of ASEAN's youth leads to new opportunities, the Republic of Korea will take the lead," Lee Jae Myung said during his opening speech.

As 2026 ASEAN chair, President Ferdinand Marcos said the regional bloc is looking forward to the continued cooperation with South Korea in "upholding international law and advancing an open, inclusive, and peaceful region."

"Our cooperation is now guided by the ASEAN-Republic of Korea Plan of Action 2026-2030, [which] encompasses collaborative efforts in maritime safety and security, strengthening energy security in the Southeast Asian region, recognizing the vital role of artificial intelligence in advancing digital cooperation, and steadfast partnership in health and technical and vocational education and training," Marcos said.
ASEAN and South Korea established sectoral dialogue relations in 1989 and the country was accorded full Dialogue Partner status in 1991. —Mariel Celine Serquiña/RF, GMA News
